frame.value: origin = Pad 2 (OLP-2) vehicle axis at ground level; x east, y up, z south
frame.ref: Origin lat 25.99680, lon -97.15804 derived from OSM (centre of the gap between Pad 2 chopstick arm ways). Cross-check: Launch Library alias OLP-2 = 25.99677,-97.15799 https://www.spacelaunchschedule.com/pad/orbital-launch-pad-2-spacex-starbase-tx-usa/ (about 4 m away).

ground_elevation_asl.ref: OSM tag ele=2.5 on way 1207227015 Starbase Integration Tower 2

pad_id.ref: Photo geometry (tower north of vehicle, camera looks NNE, OSM overlay aligns) plus Flight 14 launched from OLP-2 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starship_flight_14

flight_id.ref: Wikipedia flight 14. Photo light comes from the right/rear (sun ESE) = morning; flights 12/13 launched 17:30-17:51 CDT with sun in the west, so they are unlikely. Photo posted 22:30 on 2026-09-28 fits.

photo_time_after_liftoff.ref: vehicle bottom ~160 m above ground; net accel ~5 m/s^2 -> ~8 s (range 7-10)

vehicle_bottom_altitude_in_photo.ref: engine-skirt image row y~440 vs tower-top row y~463 (tower top ~148 m); +-12 m

tower2_centre.ref: OSM way 1207227015 footprint centre in local frame

tower2_footprint.ref: OSM footprint bbox 16x16 (way 1207227015); photo shows lattice body only ~12-13 m wide aloft, so 16 m probably includes rails/legs

tower2_body_width_photo.ref: 18-20 px wide at ~1.53 px/m in reference.jpeg

tower2_height.ref: OSM height=144.5 citing FAA OE case 619969843; Fandom OLIT-3 '474 ft (144.5 m)' https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Orbital_Launch_and_Integration_Tower_3_(OLIT-3)

tower_height_range_faa.ref: FAA structural filings list OLIT units 469-479 ft incl. lightning masts (Fandom OLIT page https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Orbital_Launch_and_Integration_Tower_(OLIT)); Wikipedia says 146 m https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SpaceX_Starbase. Conflict: 144.5 (pad 2) vs 143 (pad 1, OSM) vs 146 (Wikipedia); chosen 144.5 for pad 2.

tower_offset_from_axis.ref: from OSM tower centre (-3,-27) to axis (0,0); tower is NORTH of the vehicle

chopstick_side.value: south (+z) of tower face, i.e. towards the OLM
chopstick_side.ref: OSM gantry ways 1540152640-52 extend from tower face z=-19 to z=+8

chopstick_reach_from_tower_face.ref: OSM gantry ways (carriage z -17..-8, arms z -8..+8); crowd-mapped, +-3 m

chopstick_arm_length.ref: OSM arm ways ~16 m plus hinge; Pad B arms are 'noticeably shorter' than Pad A: https://spaceexplored.com/2025/07/28/the-key-differences-between-starships-pad-a-and-b/ ; https://www.teslaoracle.com/2025/03/25/spacex-installs-redesigned-chopsticks-pad-b-launch-tower-starship-catch-giga-bay-construction-starbase-updates/

chopstick_inner_gap_closed_x.ref: OSM arm inner edges: 12 m gap for the 9 m booster; arm axis x=+1 before origin shift

chopstick_carriage_height_in_photo.ref: crossbar with fork ends at image y~495; tower base row ~685; 1.53 px/m; +-6 m

chopstick_open_span_photo.ref: crossbar 782->852 px at 1.53 px/m (arms swung open)

qd_arm_boom_height_in_photo.ref: boom with hanging line on west side of tower at image y~585; probable QD/service arm; LOW confidence

pad2_booster_QDs.value: dual booster quick disconnects (LCH4 and LOX) on the opposite side of the mount from Pad 1

lightning_masts.value: on tower top; included in the 143-146 m FAA height

olm_height.ref: LOW confidence recollection of OLM table height; NSF forum thread 'OLM height and width' https://forum.nasaspaceflight.com/index.php?topic=58105.0 could not be fetched (403)

olm_shape_pad2.value: square/'quadratic' water-cooled deck with central circular booster opening; 20 hold-down clamp arms; rolled to Pad B 6 May 2025, lifted onto columns 12 May 2025

olm_footprint_pad2.ref: LOW confidence; chopstick outer width ~20 m plus support columns; unsourced

flame_trench_pad2.value: dedicated bathtub-shaped sheet-pile/CFA-pile reinforced-concrete trench, stainless-lined, water-cooled double-sided flame-bucket diverter beneath the mount

flame_trench_pad2_orientation.value: long axis east-west; exhaust splits east and west
flame_trench_pad2_orientation.ref: photo: cloud banks left/right, none towards camera; tower north, arms south

pad1_axis.ref: OSM tower1 centre (331.5,74.5), arms z 62..82 and x to 368 -> axis 19 m from tower face, same rule as pad 2

pad1_status.value: decommissioned 14 Oct 2025 for V3 upgrades (11 launches, 3 booster catches); under reconstruction in 2026

pad1_mount_shape.value: original circular donut mount with water-cooled steel deluge plate, no flame trench
pad1_mount_shape.ref: https://spaceexplored.com/2025/07/28/the-key-differences-between-starships-pad-a-and-b/ ; OSM shows a 'Flame Trench' polygon at pad 1 (67x77 m centre (366,74), way 1549519359)

tank_farm_extent.ref: OSM way 'SpaceX Orbital Launch Pad Tank Farm'

tank_farm_pad2_end_centre.ref: OSM 'Pad 2 LOX GSE' 58x42 m; 'Pad 2 CH4 GSE' centre (182,-59) 64x35 m

tank_horizontal_lox_ln2.ref: OSM storage_tank rectangles, LOX/LN2, centres x 219..352, z -52..-29, long axis ~12.5 deg off east-west

tank_horizontal_ch4_large.ref: OSM storage_tank ways at x 358..394, z -26..-21

tank_water_deluge.ref: OSM storage_tank content=water at x 52..98, z -72..-60 (nearest Pad 2)

coast_distance_east.ref: OSM natural=coastline ways 1230230739/975/976 at x~+750 near pad latitude

coast_bearing.value: NNW-SSE, about 6 deg east of south going south

sun_az.ref: same calc; sun ESE, ~73 deg right of camera heading
